title: DNC approves separate non-binding ICE reform and abolition resolutions
summary: The DNC approved separate non-binding resolutions calling for concrete ICE reforms and for abolition of ICE; the vote did not set the party's 2028 platform.

sources.title: Democrats disagree over abolishing or reforming ICE at DNC meeting

data.name: DNC approval of separate ICE reform and abolition resolutions
data.description: At its Austin summer meeting, the Democratic National Committee approved two separate non-binding resolutions concerning U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement:one calling for concrete reforms and another calling for abolition. The resolutions did not set the party's 2028 platform and preserve rather than resolve internal disagreement.
decisions: Approved a non-binding resolution calling for concrete reforms to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
Approved a separate non-binding resolution calling for abolition of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
The resolutions did not set the Democratic Party's 2028 platform.
actions: adopted two separate non-binding resolutions concerning ICE
